name: @lokvis/mcp-server

tools.name: lokvis_image_resize
tools.description: Resize an image to specified dimensions. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and GIF formats.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

width.description: Target width in pixels (optional, scales proportionally if omitted)

height.description: Target height in pixels (optional, scales proportionally if omitted)

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_resized.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_compress
tools.description: Compress an image to reduce file size. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF formats.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_compressed.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_convert
tools.description: Convert an image to a different format. Target formats: JPEG (lossy, no alpha), PNG (lossless, alpha), WebP (lossy/lossless, alpha), AVIF (lossy/lossless, alpha, HDR).

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_converted.<format>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_crop
tools.description: Crop an image to extract a rectangular region. Specify the top-left corner (x, y) and the region size (width, height).

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

x.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner of the crop region

y.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner of the crop region

width.description: Width of the crop region in pixels

height.description: Height of the crop region in pixels

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_cropped.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_watermark
tools.description: Add a watermark to an image (text or image watermark). Supports 9-grid positions and tile mode. Either text or image must be provided.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

text.description: Watermark text (required if image is not provided)

image.description: Watermark image URL (data URL or http(s) URL; required if text is not provided)

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_watermarked.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_rotate
tools.description: Rotate an image by a specified angle (degrees). Supports arbitrary angles; empty areas are filled with a background color.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees (e.g. 90, 180, 270, or any value)

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_rotated.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_flip
tools.description: Flip (mirror) an image along a specified axis. Supports horizontal, vertical, or both axes.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

axis.description: Flip axis: horizontal (left-right), vertical (top-bottom), or both

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_flipped.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_background
tools.description: Replace transparent areas of an image with a solid background color. Useful for converting PNG with transparency to JPEG-ready flat images.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

color.description: Background color (CSS color string, e.g. #ffffff, rgb(255,0,0))

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_bg.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_filter
tools.description: Apply a preset filter to an image. Supported filters: grayscale, invert, sepia, blur.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

radius.description: Blur radius in pixels (only for blur preset, default: 4)

output_path.description: Path for the output file (optional, defaults to input_filtered.<ext>)

tools.name: lokvis_image_favicon
tools.description: Generate a multi-size ICO favicon from an image. Non-square inputs are center-cropped to square. Output contains PNG-in-ICO entries for each specified size.

input_path.description: Path to the input image file

output_path.description: Path for the output .ico file (optional, defaults to input_favicon.ico)
